adult_schedule.description_ko: 65세 이상 무료. 그 외 연령 권장.
adult_schedule.description_en: Free for adults 65+. Recommended annually for all adults.
adult_schedule.notes_en: Free under national program for 65+. Recommended every autumn.

adult_schedule.description_en: 3-dose series for unvaccinated adults without immunity. Check surface antibody (anti-HBs) before vaccinating.
adult_schedule.notes_en: Korea has high HBV prevalence. Verify vaccination and immunity status especially for those who grew up in Korea before childhood vaccination was universal.

adult_schedule.description_en: One-time Tdap; Td booster every 10 years.
Free one-time dose for adults 65+. Younger adults with high-risk conditions should also receive it.
adult_schedule.notes_en: PPSV23 provided free for 65+. PCV higher-valent products increasingly recommended.

adult_schedule.description_en: Free for girls age 12. Catch-up recommended through age 26.
adult_schedule.notes_en: If you received care in Korea as a child, verify HPV vaccination status.

immigrant_health_notes.hepatitis_b: South Korea has a historically high prevalence of Hepatitis B. Adults who grew up in Korea before widespread childhood vaccination (before mid-1990s) may not have been vaccinated or may have acquired HBV. Testing for HBsAg and anti-HBs is recommended for all Korean-born immigrants who have not been tested.
immigrant_health_notes.tb: South Korea has an intermediate TB burden. Korean-born immigrants should discuss LTBI (latent TB infection) testing (IGRA or TST) with their US doctor, especially if not previously tested.
immigrant_health_notes.gastric_cancer: Gastric cancer incidence is significantly higher in Korea than in the United States. Korean immigrants and Korean-Americans may benefit from discussing gastric cancer screening (upper endoscopy) with their doctor, even though it is not routine in the US.
immigrant_health_notes.liver_cancer: HBV-related liver cancer is more common in Korean-Americans. Hepatitis B surface antigen testing and, if positive, liver cancer surveillance are important.
